name: paged-book-annotator
description: A local-first viewer and annotation layer for paged HTML books.

scripts.start: bun run assets && bun server.mjs --config book-viewer.config.example.json
scripts.validate:example: bun scripts/validate-book-document.mjs example/book/book.html && bun scripts/validate-navigation-document.mjs example/book/navigation.xhtml example/book/book.html
scripts.check: bun run check:version && bun scripts/check-syntax.mjs && bun test && bun run test:server
